channel.title: Navan Badminton Club
channel.description: Welcome to Navan Badminton Club located at Claremont Stadium in Navan, Co. Meath, Ireland. Club nights every Monday and Wednesday during the season which runs from September to April. Club caters for Adults and Juveniles of all standards from beginner to advanced.

item.title: Monday Club Night Fun!
item.description: Join us for a night of fun and practice with open courts and no scores. Kids' Club Night starts at 6:30pm!
item.author: badminton@navanbadmintonclub.com (Navan Badminton Club)

item.title: Vernal Equinox Fun at Navan Badminton Club Night!
item.description: Celebrate the Vernal Equinox with fun and friendly badminton practice at Thursday Club Night. No matches, just open courts for everyone to enjoy!
item.author: badminton@navanbadmintonclub.com (Navan Badminton Club)

item.title: Wednesday Club Night: Get Ready for AC!
item.description: Join us at Claremont Stadium for an exciting match between Navan 'A' and 'C'. Get ready for high-speed rallies and intense gameplay!
item.author: badminton@navanbadmintonclub.com (Navan Badminton Club)

item.title: Navan Badminton Club is Back!

item.title: Wednesday Club Night at Claremont Stadium – Badminton Fun!

item.title: Update for Our Members
item.description: No Monday Club Night due to MBA Mixed League Finals. Good luck to our teams and enjoy the Juvenile Club Night!

item.title: Thursday Club Night: Exciting Badminton Matches
item.description: Join us for an intense night of badminton matches at Thursday Club Night. Matches include Grade 5 Mens, Grade 5 Ladies, and Grade 7 Mixed teams. Best of luck to our teams in the semi-finals!
